Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
Operating income reached $12.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.67 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 86 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $0.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Revenue guidance of $27.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
